scope: Windows 11 x64 build 26300. Test-only desktop identifier, disposable folders and loopback model endpoints.
before: independent_writers_keep_both_skill_changes failed against the previous store. The second writer replaced [one] with [two]; the expected result was [one, two].
observations: Created a disabled copy in the real skill manager, cancelled an unsaved editor, made a verified out-of-process file change while a draft was open and preserved both versions by saving a separate copy.

Editing the separate copy reused its ID and kept it disabled. Removing using a stale revision failed. Restarted the native process and removed the separate copy through the UI. The original catalog and pre-test enabled choices were preserved.

A stale revision was rejected by ai_plan before the loopback server received a request. Two actual model requests showed that an enabled copy satisfied its source recommendation, the running request retained the earlier body and the next turn used the updated body.

Rust tests covered independently opened stores, migration and locked files, the 32/4 limits, duplicate saves, older source versions, preserved enable flags, ignored stale deletes, disabled copies and no resurrection on a stale edit.

tests.modelFormats: tools/ai_api_smoke.cjs --workbench, OpenAI Completions / Responses and Anthropic Messages with loopback providers
tests.edgeUi: tools/ui_smoke.cjs --builtin-skills, including compact English layout and explicit project tools for read-only folder access
